Description.Name: Sheila
Description.Details: Among all the goats that wandered the rolling pastures of Goat Path, none was more beloved by Jarl Jarlson than Sheila. A remarkably stubborn nanny goat with a snowy white coat and curled horns, Sheila possessed an uncanny ability to appear wherever Jarl happened to be—whether supervising the bottling of his famous goat milk or contemplating his unrealized dream of forging the JàrnFòlk into a Clan. Legend claims Sheila was the only living creature who could interrupt one of Jarl's lengthy military lectures without consequence. More than one unfortunate visitor discovered that insulting either Jarl's canned lutefisk or his favorite goat was a reliable way to find themselves escorted off the property by an unusually determined caprine. When asked why Sheila was his favorite, Jarl would simply smile and reply, "Unlike politicians, pirates, and distant cousins, Sheila has never lied to me. She only occasionally eats my paperwork." To this day, bottles of genuine Jarl Jarlson's Goat Milk still bear a small carving of Sheila's unmistakable profile, a quiet tribute to the goat that became almost as famous among the JàrnFòlk as Jarl himself.
